S.FORM: Padagen cigra a mihinam to kolog.
Padangen cingra a mihinam to kolong.

S.TRANSL: aide la à chercher les buffles.

FORM.notes: French volume p.001; Poinsot & Pourrias Amis-French S001_0072

S.TRANSL: s'asseoir ici ou là, c'est pareil; il n'y a qu'à avoir

FORM.notes: French volume p.002; Poinsot & Pourrias Amis-French S002_0096
French volume p.002; Poinsot & Pourrias Amis-French S002_0150

S.TRANSL: il est guéri de sa maladie

FORM.notes: French volume p.003; Poinsot & Pourrias Amis-French S003_0042

S.PHON: sa mat[o|u] ʡa[ɬ|ɮ]iʦaw k[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ is[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ton coeur est aussi dur qu'une pierre.

FORM.notes: French volume p.003; Poinsot & Pourrias Amis-French S003_0084

S.TRANSL: riz brûlé qui attache à la marmite.
伯多灣和巴利兒顧們的水牛
你坐這兒或那兒，這是一事

FORM.notes: printed p.006 l.26–p.006 l.27; alternative 1 of 3 in the source: tfod saan ko 'acfel = sa mololsa ko 'acfel = masatrocay a 'acfel
printed p.006 l.26–p.006 l.27; alternative 2 of 3 in the source: tfod saan ko 'acfel = sa mololsa ko 'acfel = masatrocay a 'acfel
printed p.006 l.26–p.006 l.27; alternative 3 of 3 in the source: tfod saan ko 'acfel = sa mololsa ko 'acfel = masatrocay a 'acfel

S.TRANSL: vieille interpellation à des gens de villages diférents.
il est guéri de sa colère.

FORM.notes: printed p.007 l.33–p.007 l.34; source: 詠 119,95

S.FORM: misa'adapaw to sapipatayaw i takowanan ko tatiihay a tamdaw
misa'adapaw to sapipatayaw i takowanan ko tatiihay a tamdaw
S.PHON: misaʡa[ɬ|ɮ]apaw t[o|u] sapipatajaw i tak[o|u]wanan k[o|u] tatiiħaj a tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw
S.TRANSL: Les impies me guettent pour me tuer

FORM.notes: printed p.007 l.35; no translation in the source

S.TRANSL: 巫師抓人的靈魂 - 用一根篙抓住一個事物
tu es aussi dur que du marbre

FORM.notes: printed p.009 l.20–p.009 l.22; source: 若 15,2

S.FORM: "O polog no cihciay a ca'ag, adimelen nira a makorac to saka loficaw no hci"
"O polong no cihciay a ca'ang, adimelen nira a makorac to saka loficaw no hci"
S.PHON: [o|u] p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ n[o|u] ʦiħʦiaj a ʦaʡaŋ a[ɬ|ɮ]iməɾən nira a mak[o|u]raʦ t[o|u] saka ɾ[o|u]fiʦaw n[o|u] ħʦi
S.TRANSL: ＂能結果實的枝子，他就修剪，使它結更多的果實＂
Tout sarment qui porte des fruits, il l'émonde afin qu'il en porte encore davantage.

S.FORM: kisraray, daidam, kacipa'ay, tayo, rakog koagy
kisraray, daidam, kacipa'ay, tayo, rakong koangy

FORM.notes: printed p.010 l.14–p.010 l.15; source: 希 4,12; source text: afafolad no toros

S.FORM: "Mata'sel no Sowal no Pa'oripay ko afafolad ato do'es"
"Mata'sel no Sowal no Pa'oripay ko afafolad ato do'es"
S.PHON: mataʡsəɾ n[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ n[o|u] paʡ[o|u]ripaj k[o|u] afaf[o|u]ɾa[ɬ|ɮ] at[o|u] [ɬ|ɮ][o|u]ʡəs
S.TRANSL: ＂天主的話有效的，關節和骨髓都能刺入＂ - 臏骨

FORM.notes: printed p.010 l.17–p.010 l.18; source: 以 63,11

S.TRANSL: 這句話是很難忍受，話中帶剌

S.FORM: maala no tao ko codad ako
maala no tao ko codad ako
S.PHON: maaɾa n[o|u] ta[o|u] k[o|u] ʦ[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ] ak[o|u]

S.TRANSL: 他們從各處來了接我們 - 他們紛紛出來接我們

FORM.notes: printed p.014 l.28–p.014 l.30; source: 詩 15,5

S.FORM: caay piala cigra to sapa'alafo to todog o sapawacay to pakainiay i awaay ko raraw a tamdaw
caay piala cingra to sapa'alafo to todong o sapawacay to pakainiay i awaay ko raraw a tamdaw
S.PHON: ʦaaj piaɾa ʦiŋra t[o|u] sapaʡaɾaf[o|u] t[o|u] t[o|u][ɬ|ɮ][o|u]ŋ [o|u] sapawaʦaj t[o|u] pakainiaj i awaaj k[o|u] raraw a tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw
S.TRANSL: 他不受賄賂來陷害無辜

S.FORM: caay ko no tamdawan a dmak
caay ko no tamdawan a dmak

FORM.notes: printed p.015 l.07–p.015 l.09; source: 詩 47,6

S.FORM: "Ma'araw nagra konini a niyaro', mackot nagra, matalaw, sakaalapkapkaw sato a milaliw"
"Ma'araw nangra konini a niyaro', mackot nangra, matalaw, sakaalapkapkaw sato a milaliw"
S.PHON: maʡaraw naŋra k[o|u]nini a nijar[o|u]ʡ maʦk[o|u]t naŋra mataɾaw sakaaɾapkapkaw sat[o|u] a miɾaɾiw
S.TRANSL: ＂他們一見，驚魂喪膽，張惶失措，狗頭鼠竄＂

S.FORM: ano komaem kako to talacay 'i, ma'alim ko wadis ako
ano komaem kako to talacay 'i, ma'alim ko wadis ako
S.PHON: an[o|u] k[o|u]maəm kak[o|u] t[o|u] taɾaʦaj ʡi maʡaɾim k[o|u] wa[ɬ|ɮ]is ak[o|u]

S.FORM: halo amo a mafana' tonini a dmak
halo amo a mafana' tonini a dmak
S.PHON: ħaɾ[o|u] am[o|u] a mafanaʡ t[o|u]nini a [ɬ|ɮ]mak

FORM.notes: printed p.022 l.37–p.022 l.38; source: 迦 2,21

S.PHON: ʦaaj ka ʡapaʦaŋ kak[o|u] t[o|u] sapaini n[o|u] paʡ[o|u]ripaj
S.TRANSL: ＂我決不願使天主的恩寵無效＂
給我們看你手上帶的東西

FORM.notes: printed p.025 l.31; source: 詞 80,3; no translation in the source
printed p.026 l.34–p.026 l.35; source: 詠 92,5

S.FORM: "Ci 'arisaysay no masoliga'ay ko loma' iso, Tapag nano da'oc a tahada'oc"
"Ci 'arisaysay no masolinga'ay ko loma' iso, Tapang nano da'oc a tahada'oc"
S.PHON: ʦi ʡarisajsaj n[o|u] mas[o|u]ɾiŋaʡaj k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ is[o|u] tapaŋ nan[o|u] [ɬ|ɮ]aʡ[o|u]ʦ a taħa[ɬ|ɮ]aʡ[o|u]ʦ
S.TRANSL: ＂上主呵，你的殿宇永遠應亨神聖＂

S.FORM: arkah ko fages no fa'inayan, nawhan adihay ko gisgis
arkah ko fanges no fa'inayan, nawhan adihay ko ngisngis
S.PHON: arkaħ k[o|u] faŋəs n[o|u] faʡinajan nawħan a[ɬ|ɮ]iħaj k[o|u] ŋisŋis

水泥無足夠的水，攪拌面乾裂

S.FORM: fagcalay ko riko' nira, asimaan ko nomako
fangcalay ko riko' nira, asimaan ko nomako
S.PHON: faŋʦaɾaj k[o|u] rik[o|u]ʡ nira asimaan k[o|u] n[o|u]mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 他的衣服姣好，我的是很普通的

S.FORM: kasimaanay saan cagra to dafog ako
kasimaanay saan cangra to dafong ako

S.PHON: taŋiʦ n[o|u] ast[o|u]ɾiʦ ħananaj a ʡajam

FORM.notes: printed p.029 l.16–p.029 l.17; source: 斐 1,23
printed p.029 l.28–p.029 l.29; source: 可 5,25

S.FORM: "Ira ko ccay a fafahian, o ma'atalisay"
"Ira ko ccay a fafahian, o ma'atalisay"
S.PHON: ira k[o|u] ʦʦaj a fafaħian [o|u] maʡataɾisaj
S.TRANSL: ＂有了一個女人患了十二年的血崩＂
可食用植物蔓榕(蕨類植物的莖)

FORM.notes: printed p.030 l.28–p.030 l.29; source: 路 15,18

S.TRANSL: 無剩餘的，也可以解釋，成沒有用

S.PHON: paɾaawajən k[o|u] ʡp[o|u]ʦ k[o|u] nipipas[o|u]waɾ nira
S.TRANSL: 作得那樣別人不了解他要講的話

FORM.notes: printed p.031 l.27–p.031 l.28; source: 谷 14,35

"ano mama'deng a mi'awas cingranan tona toki"
S.PHON: an[o|u] mamaʡ[ɬ|ɮ]əŋ a miʡawas ʦiŋranan t[o|u]na t[o|u]ki
S.TRANSL: ＂若是可以，不使他經歷這個痛苦＂
哦！我給你那麼多的憂慮

FORM.notes: printed p.032 l.14–p.032 l.16; source: 羅 8,29

S.FORM: "Oya nili'ayawan no Kawas a kafana' i tamdaw 'i, li'ayawen nira a mihapinag"
"Oya nili'ayawan no Kawas a kafana' i tamdaw 'i, li'ayawen nira a mihapinang"
S.PHON: [o|u]ja niɾiʡajawan n[o|u] kawas a kafanaʡ i tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw ʡi ɾiʡajawən nira a miħapinaŋ
S.TRANSL: ＂因為上主預知他們，把他們預光棌揀選來＂

FORM.notes: printed p.032 l.34–p.032 l.35; no translation in the source
printed p.036 l.15–p.036 l.16; source: 谷 5,24

S.PHON: maʦaʦiŋri k[o|u] ʡaɾ[o|u]manaj a mit[o|u][o|u]r ʦi jis[o|u]an

FORM.notes: printed p.037 l.16–p.037 l.17; source: 詩 90,12; no translation in the source

S.FORM: "A macada no kamay no coyoh kiso"
"A macada no kamay no coyoh kiso"
S.PHON: a maʦa[ɬ|ɮ]a n[o|u] kamaj n[o|u] ʦ[o|u]j[o|u]ħ kis[o|u]
ʦa[ɬ|ɮ]aən n[o|u] ʦ[o|u]j[o|u]ħ t[o|u] kamaj kis[o|u]

S.FORM: o saca'desay a dmak no lisin
o saca'desay a dmak no lisin

FORM.notes: printed p.037 l.30–p.037 l.33; source: 詩 89,11

S.FORM: "Cima ko mafana'ay o nika ca'des no kter iso"
"Cima ko mafana'ay o nika ca'des no kter iso"
S.PHON: ʦima k[o|u] mafanaʡaj [o|u] nika ʦaʡ[ɬ|ɮ]əs n[o|u] ktər is[o|u]

FORM.notes: printed p.038 l.31–p.038 l.32; source: 詩 92,1

S.PHON: na mita[o|u]ʡ k[o|u] paʡ[o|u]ripaj mamiʦaʡfaŋ k[o|u] ʡ[ɬ|ɮ]iɾ

FORM.notes: printed p.039 l.34–p.039 l.36; source: 撒上 10,19

S.FORM: "Kacagalen kamo anini konini a mipa'oripay tamowanan a Kawas na i pades namo"
"Kacangalen kamo anini konini a mipa'oripay tamowanan a Kawas na i pades namo"
S.PHON: kaʦaŋaɾən kam[o|u] anini k[o|u]nini a mipaʡ[o|u]ripaj tam[o|u]wanan a kawas na i pa[ɬ|ɮ]əs nam[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂上主救你們脫離一切災禍和患難，但是今天，你們厭棄上主＂
那個孩子帶給別人煩燥 - 那孩子們被驚嘛

kita o itiniay tona cahong 'i, mi'orong to kahtengay a tomangic
S.PHON: kita [o|u] itiniaj t[o|u]na ʦaħ[o|u]ŋ ʡi miʡ[o|u]r[o|u]ŋ t[o|u] kaħtəŋaj a t[o|u]maŋiʦ
S.TRANSL: 我們居住在這臨時的地方要哭出來背重擔

FORM.notes: printed p.041 l.23–p.041 l.24; source: 民 7,5

S.FORM: "Oya picahok to nanom, o matiya o pinanom to waco 'i, cideken"
"Oya picahok to nanom, o matiya o pinanom to waco 'i, cideken"
S.PHON: [o|u]ja piʦaħ[o|u]k t[o|u] nan[o|u]m [o|u] matija [o|u] pinan[o|u]m t[o|u] waʦ[o|u] ʡi ʦi[ɬ|ɮ]əkən

pacakaten to tireng iso ato faloco' iso i Pa'oripay
S.PHON: paʦakatən t[o|u] tirəŋ is[o|u] at[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ is[o|u] i paʡ[o|u]ripaj

S.FORM: o maan ko sapacakat noya misalisinay?
o maan ko sapacakat noya misalisinay?

FORM.notes: printed p.042 l.30–p.042 l.31; source: 詩 17,29

S.FORM: "Pafli ko Tapag ko malo'icel a micakod to takaraway a 'adipel"
"Pafli ko Tapang ko malo'icel a micakod to takaraway a 'adipel"
S.PHON: pafɾi k[o|u] tapaŋ k[o|u] maɾ[o|u]ʡiʦəɾ a miʦak[o|u][ɬ|ɮ] t[o|u] takarawaj a ʡa[ɬ|ɮ]ipəɾ
S.TRANSL: ＂天主給我力量能夠摧毀他們的防禦＂

FORM.notes: printed p.043 l.24–p.043 l.25; source: 詩 03,17

S.FORM: "Padipog ko tolatolaw i caleg a kilag"
"Padipong ko tolatolaw i caleng a kilang"
S.PHON: pa[ɬ|ɮ]ip[o|u]ŋ k[o|u] t[o|u]ɾat[o|u]ɾaw i ʦaɾəŋ a kiɾaŋ
S.TRANSL: ＂鳥兒在香柏樹(雪松樹)裏築巢＂

FORM.notes: printed p.043 l.27–p.043 l.29; source: 詩 107,26

S.FORM: "Saca'owa'owaw sa ko lonan nagra, sacalemcem sa cagra, saka matoled nagra"
"Saca'owa'owaw sa ko lonan nangra, sacalemcem sa cangra, saka matoled nangra"
S.PHON: saʦaʡ[o|u]waʡ[o|u]waw sa k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]nan naŋra saʦaɾəmʦəm sa ʦaŋra saka mat[o|u]ɾə[ɬ|ɮ] naŋra
S.TRANSL: ＂危舟被打上高空，又下沈到深淵

S.FORM: macalig no tao ko omah ako
macaling no tao ko omah ako

FORM.notes: printed p.044 l.20–p.044 l.22; source: 若 11,31

S.FORM: "Paka'araw ko mikapotay a mirinom ci Mariaan tonika caloh ci Maria a masadak"
"Paka'araw ko mikapotay a mirinom ci Mariaan tonika caloh ci Maria a masadak"
S.PHON: pakaʡaraw k[o|u] mikap[o|u]taj a mirin[o|u]m ʦi mariaan t[o|u]nika ʦaɾ[o|u]ħ ʦi maria a masa[ɬ|ɮ]ak
S.TRANSL: ＂那些到家退裡安慰瑪利亞的人，看見她急忙起身出去＂...

FORM.notes: printed p.044 l.31–p.044 l.35; source: 詩 50,19

S.FORM: "Caloway somowal kiso to tatiihay, caloway kiso a misamagah a somowal"
"Caloway somowal kiso to tatiihay, caloway kiso a misamangah a somowal"
S.PHON: ʦaɾ[o|u]waj s[o|u]m[o|u]waɾ kis[o|u] t[o|u] tatiiħaj ʦaɾ[o|u]waj kis[o|u] a misamaŋaħ a s[o|u]m[o|u]waɾ
S.TRANSL: ＂你的嘴巴隨時說壞話，你的舌頭隨地撒謊＂

FORM.notes: printed p.044 l.31–p.044 l.35; source: 詩 119,173

S.FORM: "Nanay! o kacalowayan ako kiso a milogoc to mipadama iso"
"Nanay! o kacalowayan ako kiso a milongoc to mipadama iso"
S.PHON: nanaj [o|u] kaʦaɾ[o|u]wajan ak[o|u] kis[o|u] a miɾ[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ʦ t[o|u] mipa[ɬ|ɮ]ama is[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂求你隨時幫助我，因為我遵從你的命令＂ -

S.FORM: mafana' cigra a maca'mot to sowal
mafana' cingra a maca'mot to sowal
S.PHON: mafanaʡ ʦiŋra a maʦaʡm[o|u]t t[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ

S.FORM: mimaan kiso a maro' i cani'iw no loma'
mimaan kiso a maro' i cani'iw no loma'
S.PHON: mimaan kis[o|u] a mar[o|u]ʡ i ʦaniʡiw n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ
S.TRANSL: 你坐在家裡面 趕什麼？

S.FORM: "Mafoti' ci Yiso i cani'iw no tamina"
"Mafoti' ci Yiso i cani'iw no tamina"
S.PHON: maf[o|u]tiʡ ʦi jis[o|u] i ʦaniʡiw n[o|u] tamina

FORM.notes: printed p.045 l.34–p.045 l.37; source: 若 20,19

S.FORM: "Canikeren no misawawaan ko sasa'def no kasa'opoan a loma'"
"Canikeren no misawawaan ko sasa'def no kasa'opoan a loma'"
S.PHON: ʦanikərən n[o|u] misawawaan k[o|u] sasaʡ[ɬ|ɮ]əf n[o|u] kasaʡ[o|u]p[o|u]an a ɾ[o|u]maʡ
S.TRANSL: ＂他們聚在一起，門緊緊地關者...＂

FORM.notes: printed p.045 l.34–p.045 l.37; source: 若 20,26

S.FORM: "Macaniker ko sasa' def, taini ci Yiso i sifo' nagra"
"Macaniker ko sasa' def, taini ci Yiso i sifo' nangra"
S.PHON: maʦanikər k[o|u] sasaʡ [ɬ|ɮ]əf taini ʦi jis[o|u] i sif[o|u]ʡ naŋra
S.TRANSL: ＂門開者，可是耶穌忽然顯現，站在他們當中...＂

FORM.notes: printed p.046 l.37–p.046 l.38; source: 賽 53,3

S.FORM: "Mararomay a tamdaw cigra a micapopoay to pades"
"Mararomay a tamdaw cingra a micapopoay to pades"
S.PHON: marar[o|u]maj a tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw ʦiŋra a miʦap[o|u]p[o|u]aj t[o|u] pa[ɬ|ɮ]əs

FORM.notes: printed p.047 l.22; no translation in the source

S.FORM: pacarcar ho ko harateg ako anini
pacarcar ho ko harateng ako anini
S.PHON: paʦarʦar ħ[o|u] k[o|u] ħaratəŋ ak[o|u] anini

S.FORM: o mipacarcaray kako a maro' itini
o mipacarcaray kako a maro' itini

FORM.notes: printed p.047 l.24–p.047 l.28; source: 徒 18,23

S.FORM: Pacarcar sa ci Pawlo itira to pinapina a romi'ad
Pacarcar sa ci Pawlo itira to pinapina a romi'ad
S.PHON: paʦarʦar sa ʦi pawɾ[o|u] itira t[o|u] pinapina a r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ]
S.TRANSL: 保羅在那裡住了一些日子

FORM.notes: printed p.047 l.38–p.047 l.40; source: 加 6,17
